quote: Aerodynamically, a bumblebee shouldn't be able to fly. Its wings are too small and its body too big. But the bumblebee doesn't know that — so it flies anyway.
author: Unknown
note: Be the bumblebee. Love you girls! — Daddy

quote: Everyone knows we need to have mud for lotuses to grow. The mud doesn't smell so good, but the lotus flower smells very good. If you don't have mud, the lotus won't manifest. You can't grow lotus flowers on marble. Without mud, there can be no lotus.
author: Thich Nhat Hanh
note: The hard stuff helps you bloom. Love you girls! — Daddy

quote: Do the best you can until you know better. Then when you know better, do better.
author: Maya Angelou
note: You're learning and growing every day. I love you and I'm so proud of you! — Daddy

quote: I am building a fire, and every day I train, I add more fuel. At just the right moment, I light the match.
author: Mia Hamm
note: Keep showing up and putting in the work — your moment is coming! Love you girls! — Daddy

quote: I figure, if a girl wants to be a legend, she should go ahead and be one.
author: Possibly Calamity Jane (but definitely true)
note: Go be legendary today. I believe in you! Love you girls! — Daddy

quote:
Because you see, Jade, the difference between you and me is your body, it's built for show. While mine, it's built for fighting. You work out so you're more aesthetically pleasing. I work out so my body can survive and thrive within this business. So when that bell rings, you can flex all you want. It doesn't matter because I am going to fight. And I'm gonna take that title from you. And I'm gonna take it with force. And there's not a damn thing you can do about it.

Do you know who I am? I am Rhea BLOODY Ripley!
author: Rhea Ripley
note: Whatever you're up against today, don't back down. You were built for this. Love you girls! — Daddy

quote:
An elder sits with his granddaughter by a fire and says, "There is a battle going on inside me. It has been going on my whole life, and it goes on inside you too. Two wolves are fighting. One is fed by *fear* — he grows on doubt, anger, and the voice that says you are not enough. The other is fed by *courage* — he grows on love, hope, and the quiet belief that you can."

The girl stared into the fire. "Which one wins, grandfather?"

He looked at her and said, *"Whichever one you feed."*
author: Old folk tale
note: You already know which wolf to feed. Love you girls! — Daddy
